tools.name: verify_artist
tools.description: Verify an artist: search by name in the Stage 0 registry (tracks, rights) or by wallet address on instances with a blockchain layer

artist_name.description: Artist's stage name (primary method — Stage 0 registry, case-insensitive)

wallet_address.description: Ethereum wallet address (0x...) — only for instances with a blockchain layer

tools.name: get_artist_passport
tools.description: Fetch the full artist passport record

tools.name: check_track_ownership
tools.description: Check track ownership by ISRC

tools.name: get_royalty_balance
tools.description: Check the royalty balance for a track

tools.name: get_label_info
tools.description: Fetch label information

tools.name: get_system_stats
tools.description: Fetch overall NDP system statistics

tools.name: check_artist_tracks
tools.description: Fetch the number of tracks by an artist

tools.name: start_ucp_checkout
tools.description: Start a track purchase via NDP Checkout (UCP-compatible)

tools.name: trigger_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Trigger an n8n workflow (e.g. passport minting or verification)

tools.name: identify_track
tools.description: Identify a track by its ADNA fingerprint (anti-plagiarism; verdict same/derivative/different) or fetch track data by ISRC from the Stage 0 registry. v2 (adna_v2) adds localization: offset_sec, coverage, attribution map f

adna.description: ADNA v1 fingerprint (base64, 256 bytes ≈ 344 chars) — run through the oracle

adna_v2.description: ADNA v2 fingerprint (base64, starts with QTI; windowed signatures, ~KB scale) — aligned identification: finds fragments, cut-offs, pitch ±8%

tools.name: register_track
tools.description: Register a track in the Stage 0 registry (registry-api + oracle, dual write): ISRC, ADNA, splits, optional derivative link (parent_isrc)

adna_v2.description: ADNA v2 fingerprint (base64, starts with QTI) — optional, mirrored to the oracle for aligned identification

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the reference audio file (optional)

parent_isrc.description: ISRC of the source track if this is a derivative (remix/sample)

splits.description: Royalty shares, Σ=100; cascade: {role:'parent', wallet:'isrc:<ISRC>', share:N}

tools.name: get_track_manifest
tools.description: Fetch a track's NDT manifest (rights, splits, sonic-dna) from the Stage 0 registry

tools.name: audience_superfans
tools.description: SPEC §7.7 fan agent: an artist's superfans derived from protocol receipts (who listens / rewinds / pays). Requires an agent token issued by the artist via POST /subjects/{ndp_id}/scopes/issue (mandate with the read_audie

agent_token.description: Agent JWT from scopes/issue (with the read_audience scope)

limit.description: How many listeners to return (1–100, default 20)

tools.name: audience_summary
tools.description: SPEC §7.7 fan agent: artist audience summary from receipts — listeners, events, rewinds, total paid, active in the last 30 days. Requires an agent token with the read_audience scope

tools.name: subject_mint
tools.description: SPEC §1: mint an NDP passport (Proof of Humanity). Three verification paths: label / indie_kyc / community. Returns ndp_id, status, quarantine flag

identity_commitment.description: SHA-256 hash of a unique ID (64 hex chars)

tools.name: subject_status
tools.description: SPEC §1: public check of an NDP passport by ndp_id — status, verification path, validity

tools.name: subject_keys
tools.description: SPEC §1: manage a subject's device keys — list keys

tools.name: receipt_batch
tools.description: SPEC §7.1: batch submission of signed play receipts. Body — an array of objects {receipt_id, seq, ndp_id, device_key, isrc, action, occurred_at, signature}

tools.name: stats_journal
tools.description: Daily event journal (play/rewind/purchase, totals, chart) from the unified receipt journal

tools.name: opt_in
tools.description: SPEC §7.7: toggle a listener's opt-in for audience segmentation (privacy-first: hidden by default)

tools.name: snapshot_epoch
tools.description: SPEC §1: current epoch snapshot of subject statuses (signed with SNAPSHOT_SIGNING_KEY)
